text: Multiple employees are unable to connect to the corporate VPN and cannot access internal resources.
Users are unable to log into GitHub Enterprise because authentication is failing.

The office Wi-Fi connection is extremely slow for users on the third floor.
Employees cannot reset their company passwords because the password reset portal shows an error.

A user's laptop keyboard has several keys that are no longer responding.
